item.title: Top 5 Solutions to Prevent Detection of Selenium with Chromedriver
item.description:
How Can a Website Detect When You’re Using Selenium with Chromedriver?

When working with Selenium and Chromedriver for web automation, you might encounter websites that can detect your use of automation tools. This detection can occur even when you’re simply browsing manually, leading to issues like blocked access or warnings about suspicious activities. This raises an important question: How do websites identify that Selenium is being used, and what steps can you take to alleviate this problem?
